Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno AND activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter: assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054503') AND standard_value IS NOT NULL AND standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
